title: Greenfield Office — Recycling and Waste Policy
sourceNotes: Naskah orisinal tim Success IELTS, tidak diambil dari buku atau tes resmi manapun.

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text: Starting this month, Greenfield Office is introducing a new recycling policy for all staff. The aim is to reduce the amount of waste sent to landfill by at least thirty percent by the end of the year.

paragraphs.label: B
paragraphs.text: Each floor will have three separate bins: blue for paper and cardboard, green for plastic bottles and containers, and black for general waste that cannot be recycled. Please make sure food waste is placed in the black bin, not the green one, as food can contaminate recyclable plastic.

paragraphs.label: C
paragraphs.text: Printer paper should be reused where possible before being recycled. A tray has been placed next to each printer for paper that has only been printed on one side. Staff are encouraged to use this paper for notes and draft documents.

paragraphs.label: D
paragraphs.text: Electronic waste, such as old phones, cables, and batteries, must not be placed in any of the three bins. Instead, bring these items to the collection box in the main reception area, which is emptied every Friday by our recycling partner, Clearwaste Ltd.

paragraphs.label: E
paragraphs.text: Staff who have questions about the new policy should contact the Office Manager, Priya Shah, at extension 204, or visit the information page on the staff noticeboard outside the kitchen.
